advisory_criteria: Next do-now atom after impl-0014 should be impl-0015 workflow hardening: make workflow-level audit/status failures visible, and add an automated changed-path/scope closeout gate comparing actual changed paths with expected and forbidden atom scope.
Current implementor policy: use GPT Codex workers selected by complexity tier; do not start new GLM/OpenCode implementors for this effort.
Current discovery policy: the orchestrator and all subagents must start from Idiom discovery tools where they apply, beginning with context_pack.

Coverage quality policy: parser/audit/status/brief/closeout atoms require focused contract tests, one realistic human-authored fixture variant for artifact parsing, a negative fixture-level CLI test with typed finding or blocker assertions, durable fixture pass coverage, and privacy/audit assertions where outputs include reports/status/telemetry/evidence/history.
Deferred follow-up: harden PRD/ADR parsing before broader user-authored artifacts are accepted; current parsers are fixture-oriented and string-shaped.
Deferred follow-up: decide and encode TDD reference authority policy, current tdd.json only versus workflow-known historical implementation-ledger IDs.

Deferred follow-up: continue remaining design-doc product surfaces after Phase 1 hardening, including research profiles, generation, acceptance/supersession, brief dispatch, coverage gates, feedback, and operator surfaces.

Phase 4 brief generation is complete: idiom product brief --render creates lint-verified implementation briefs from accepted PRD/ADR/TDD artifacts and a passing coverage gate without dispatching work or executing models.
Deferred follow-up: make coverage gate reuse product lint/audit validators or run them as blocking preconditions before brief generation.

Atom 29 complete: idiom product feedback links explicit lane/progress/evidence references into privacy-safe execution feedback summaries without dispatching lanes, mutating .idiom runtime state, writing evidence exports, or promoting ranker learning.

Atom 30 complete: idiom product feedback reconciliation consumes passing feedback summaries and writes deterministic reconciled workflow-state output with bounded artifact/evidence links, while preserving dispatch, .idiom runtime mutation, evidence export generation, and ranker-learning boundaries.

Atom 31 complete: product audit and product status expose deterministic product-workflow metrics for progress, gates, blockers, TDD, ledger, reports, artifacts, and evidence-link counts without dispatching lanes, mutating .idiom runtime state, writing evidence exports, promoting ranker learning, or enforcing Obsidian parity.

Atom 32 complete: product lint/audit/status now include deterministic Obsidian parity checks for stale proposal/roadmap status, with an explicit no-change rationale path and fail-closed missing-note behavior.

Atom 33 complete: product lint/audit/status JSON and human-readable outputs expose deterministic status labels, typed finding or blocker identities, and actionable next-valid-action text; audit-fail status output now prioritizes live remediation over stale workflow-state progression.

Atom 34 complete: idiom product feedback --ranker-learning-evidence-summary adapts verified execution feedback into bounded ranker-learning request-shaped evidence without promoting ranker weights, dispatching lanes, mutating .idiom runtime state, writing evidence exports, or storing raw content.
Next design-doc slice: plan the Phase 6 operator status and continuation surface so CLI/TUI can present the same durable workflow state and valid next actions.

Atom 35 complete: product status exposes a shared read-only operator view behind --operator-view with typed next actions, owners, blockers, freshness, metrics, and artifact paths; default status JSON/text remains stable and no lane dispatch, model execution, .idiom runtime mutation, status-folder migration, or broad TUI behavior was added.
Next design-doc slice: plan impl-0036 for browsing product workflow efforts by status bucket using a read-only CLI surface, before broader status-folder migration or TUI effort-browser work.
